title: Nesvizh Castle
visualBrief: Restored ochre palace around its open irregular six-sided courtyard, distinct gate and palace towers with swept metal crowns, red tiled roofs, curved western galleries, ceremonial gate passage, stone arch bridge and grass bastions.

nativeAxes.front: West gate and approach bridge toward native -X; +Z south-southwest
nativeAxes.origin: Mapped grounds anchor with provisional moat-side ground datum

sourceFacts.identity: Q719422 grounds relation/14560856; palace building relation/1732915 with inner court way/128279266.

reconstruction.basis: OSM building parts, roof heights and min-height tags plus current museum courtyard photograph and UNDP 2021 exterior photograph.
reconstruction.state: Restored palace exterior; historical engraving informs context only.
reconstruction.verticalDatum: Provisional palace/court datum Y=4 above moat-side ground; mapped 33 m palace tower tip gives Y=37, finial Y=37.9. Earth-bank crests Y=8 are estimates.

geographicProposal.reviewStatus: Draft pending terrain heights, roof fit and directional placement review
geographicProposal.notes: Castle grounds include open courtyard and earth banks. Never extrude or replace the whole grounds envelope as one building.

scaleBasis: Meter-scale map parts. Individual roof sections preserve mapped floor/roof heights. Facade rhythms, ornamental profiles and terrain levels remain an original visual reconstruction.
geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.
sourceLicense: Original reconstruction under repository license. Map-derived plan evidence: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference publications are linked, not redistributed.
dataAttribution: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference photographs were inspected; no third-party photographs or meshes are embedded.
materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.
reviewStatus: source-geometry; near/far and shared-material captures pending
limitations: Maximum exterior fidelity remains pending: individual pilasters, clock faces, heraldic and figurative sculpture, exact window rhythms, dormers and roof junctions require more reference work.
Ground datum, rampart slopes, bridge arches and terrace levels are inferred rather than surveyed; in-world terrain fit has not passed. Water and park trees belong to the host terrain layers.

Some roof geometry and facade profiles are reconstructed; curved gallery roofs and stacked tower profiles need further photographic refinement. Palace interiors, wider park and the separate Corpus Christi Church are outside this exterior asset.
Detailed source retains tiled roof courses and window reveals. Four separate runtime tiers share plaster, ceramic tile, stone, wood and metal; no embedded images. Physical device approval is pending.
importReason: Preserve thin facade frames, panel joints and crown/antenna details until a measured LOD chain is authored.
